attackers_goals: Exfiltrate token and abuse it remotely.
description: A GCP Service Account token, which is attached to an app engine, was used externally of the cloud environment.
investigative_actions: Check if the Service Account was attached to a specific app engine. Check if the Service Account was used by a user. Check if the relevant app engine is compromised.
name: Remote usage of an App engine Service Account token
